title: Fantasy Player News
description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Xavier McKinney (foot) questionable to play Sunday
items.desc: Xavier McKinney (foot) is questionable to play in Sunday's game against the Minnesota Vikings.
items.impact: McKinney is uncertain to play on Sunday, as he is currently considered questionable to play due to a groin issue. He is one of Green Bay's best defensive players, so their secondary will be considerably worse if he's sidelined this week.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Andrew Wingard (groin) considered questionable for Sunday
items.desc: Andrew Wingard (groin) is considered questionable for Sunday's game against the Los Angeles Rams.
items.impact: Wingard may not be available to play on Sunday, as he's currently dealing with a groin issue of some kind that left him sidelined for Thursday and Friday's practices. Arizona's secondary will be weaker than usual if he's ruled out.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Max Melton (knee/hand) questionable for Sunday
items.desc: Max Melton (knee/hand) is questionable for Sunday's game against the Los Angeles Rams.
items.impact: The Cardinals are unsure if Melton will be available to play this weekend, as he's currently dealing with a couple of different injuries. The team will make an official decision regarding his availability closer to game time.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Hunter Long (knee) listed questionable for Sunday
items.desc: Hunter Long (knee) is listed questionable for Sunday's game against the Los Angeles Rams.
items.impact: Long's knee injury leaves him with a questionable tag heading into the weekend. His potential absence on Sunday wouldn't have a big impact for fantasy purposes, however.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Tyler Higbee (illness) good to go for Sunday
items.desc: Tyler Higbee (illness) is good to go for Sunday's game against the Arizona Cardinals.
items.impact: Higbee has recovered from the illness that was bothering him earlier in the week and will be good to go for Sunday's game. He hasn't been productive lately but will have a chance to step up and see more work on an injury-riddled Rams' offense in Week 10.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Myles Garrett (knee) officially questionable for Sunday
items.desc: Myles Garrett (knee) is officially questionable for Sunday's game against the Arizona Cardinals.
items.impact: The star edge rusher is going to be questionable to play on Sunday, as he's still managing a lingering knee issue right now. He is reportedly expected to play, however, which would be a significant benefit to Los Angeles' defense this week.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Colby Parkinson (ribs) off injury report for Sunday
items.desc: Colby Parkinson (ribs) is off of the injury report for Sunday's game against the Arizona Cardinals.
items.impact: Parkinson was limited at practice earlier in the week due to an injury to his ribs, but he was able to log a full practice session on Friday and is now off of the injury report heading into the weekend. He should be a full go against the Cardinals.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Davis Allen (oblique) questionable for Sunday
items.desc: Davis Allen (oblique) is questionable for Sunday's game against the Arizona Cardinals.
items.impact: Allen is uncertain to play on Sunday. He's recovering from an oblique injury right now and is officially questionable to play as a result. His potential absence would possibly lead to more work for Tyler Higbee this week.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Reed Blankenship (concussion/hand) cleared to play Sunday
items.desc: Reed Blankenship (concussion/hand) has been cleared to play in Sunday's game against the Cleveland Browns.
items.impact: Blankenship has missed multiple games while recovering from a couple of different injuries, but he has received full clearance to make his return to the lineup in Week 10 and will play against the Browns. Houston's secondary should see a nice boost with him back in the lineup moving forward.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Wyatt Teller (back/illness) considered questionable for Sunday
items.desc: Wyatt Teller (back/illness) is considered questionable for Sunday's game against the Cleveland Browns.
items.impact: Teller is uncertain to play against his former team on Sunday. He's dealing with multiple different issues right now, and it's unclear if he's trending towards sitting out or not. His absence would be keenly felt this week with Keylan Rutledge (neck/shoulder) already ruled out for the Texans.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Keylan Rutledge (neck/shoulder) unavailable for Sunday
items.desc: Keylan Rutledge (neck/shoulder) will be unavailable for Sunday's game against the Cleveland Browns.
items.impact: The Texans are going to be without their starting left guard on Sunday, as they have ruled out Rutledge due to a neck/shoulder issue of some kind. Wyatt Teller (back/illness) and Trent Brown (wrist) are both questionable to play as well, so their offensive line might be significantly weaker than usual against the Browns this week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Kyle Van Noy (calf) listed questionable Sunday
items.desc: Kyle Van Noy is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Packers.
items.impact: Van Noy will need to be monitored closer to kickoff on Sunday.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Azeez Al-Shaair (groin/personal) sidelined for Sunday
items.desc: Azeez Al-Shaair (groin/personal) will be sidelined for Sunday's game against the Cleveland Browns.
items.impact: Al-Shaair is going to be sidelined on Sunday due to a pair of issues that he's dealing with. The Texans have already ruled out multiple key defenders for this game, so their defense is going to be much weaker than usual in this matchup against Cleveland.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jordan Addison (thumb) listed questionable Sunday
items.desc: Jordan Addison is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Packers.
items.impact: Addison is battling a thumb injury. He will need to be monitored closer to kickoff.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Trent Brown (wrist) listed questionable for Sunday
items.desc: Trent Brown (wrist) is listed questionable for Sunday's game against the Cleveland Browns.
items.impact: Brown is managing a wrist issue of some kind right now and is going to be questionable to play in Week 10 as a result. Houston's offensive front will be weaker than usual if he's unable to play against the Browns this week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Carson Wentz (ankle) off injury report Sunday
items.desc: Carson Wentz is off the injury report for Sunday's game against the Packers.
items.impact: Wentz will backup Kirk Cousins on Sunday.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Will Anderson Jr. (ankle) questionable to play Sunday
items.desc: Will Anderson Jr. (ankle) is questionable to play in Sunday's game against the Cleveland Browns.
items.impact: Anderson was added to the injury report on Thursday due to an ankle issue and is officially considered questionable to play heading into the weekend because of it. The Texans have already ruled out Danielle Hunter (hamstring), so if Anderson is sidelined as well, their defensive front will be much less formidable than usual against the Browns this week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Kyler Murray (hamstring) ruled out Sunday
items.desc: Kyler Murray has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Packers.
items.impact: Murray remains week-to-week. He will be the backup when he is healthy.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jauan Jennings (calf) ruled out Sunday
items.desc: Jauan Jennings has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Packers.
items.impact: Jennings remains off the fantasy radar when he is healthy.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Blake Cashman (concussion) ruled out Sunday
items.desc: Blake Cashman has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Packers.
items.impact: Cashman will be sidelined as he remains in concussion protocol.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Marvin Harrison Jr. (hamstring) ruled out for Sunday
items.desc: Marvin Harrison Jr. (hamstring) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Cleveland Browns.
items.impact: Harrison wasn't able to practice throughout the week due to a hamstring injury, so it's unsurprising that he has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Browns. He hasn't been getting many targets for Houston recently, but his absence may still open up some opportunities for Xavier Hutchinson and Kayshon Boutte this week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: T.J. Hockenson (wrist/chest) ruled out Sunday
items.desc: T.J. Hockenson has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Packers.
items.impact: Hockenson was unable to get healthy enough in time on a short week.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Danielle Hunter (hamstring) sidelined for Sunday
items.desc: Danielle Hunter (hamstring) will be sidelined for Sunday's game against the Cleveland Browns.
items.impact: The Texans are set to be without one of their key defenders on Sunday. Hunter suffered a hamstring injury at practice on Thursday and won't be available to play in Week 10 as a result. Houston will have a short turnaround after this game, since they play in the Thursday night game in Week 11, which could mean a multi-game absence for the veteran.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Adonai Mitchell (knee) listed questionable Sunday
items.desc: Adonai Mitchell is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Bills.
items.impact: Mitchell was added to the injury report on Friday, but he was still able to log a full practice. He should be on the favorable side of questionable.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Brevin Jordan (finger/foot) unavailable for Sunday
items.desc: Brevin Jordan (finger/foot) will be unavailable for Sunday's game against the Cleveland Browns.
items.impact: The Texans will be without Jordan on Sunday as he continues to recover from a pair of injuries. His absence won't have a very big impact from a fantasy perspective, however.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Omar Cooper Jr. (ankle) listed questionable Sunday
items.desc: Omar Cooper Jr. is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Bills.
items.impact: Cooper ended the week with a full practice. He is on the favorable side of questionable heading into Sunday.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Garrett Wilson (concussion) listed questionable Sunday
items.desc: Garrett Wilson is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Bills.
items.impact: Wilson ended the week with a full practice. He remains on track to clear concussion protocol and be good to go for Sunday.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Tank Dell (hand/shoulder) good to go for Sunday
items.desc: Tank Dell (hand/shoulder) is good to go for Sunday's game against the Cleveland Browns.
items.impact: Dell will be good to go on Sunday. Neither of his two injuries are serious at this point, and his snaps are expected to continue to increase for a little while as he continues to look great in his return from injury. He may be inconsistent for a while but will have solid week-to-week upside for the foreseeable future.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Woody Marks (knee) off injury report for Sunday
items.desc: Woody Marks (knee) is off of the injury report for Sunday's game against the Cleveland Browns.
items.impact: Marks is set to be a full go on Sunday, despite managing a knee injury at practice throughout the week. He will only see enough work to be fantasy relevant if David Montgomery (groin) is ruled out ahead of game time, however.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: David Montgomery (groin) officially questionable for Sunday
items.desc: David Montgomery (groin) is officially questionable for Sunday's game against the Cleveland Browns.
items.impact: Montgomery has been out for most of the season due to a lingering groin issue, but he was able to practice in full on Friday and will have a real chance to make his return to the lineup on Sunday. The team will make a decision about his availability closer to game time, and if he's cleared to play, fantasy managers should expect Woody Marks to see significantly less work moving forward.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Kirk Cousins officially starting Sunday for Vikings
items.desc: Vikings head coach Kevin O'Connell has announced that QB Kirk Cousins will start Sunday at Green Bay.
items.impact: This was the expectation and it is now official. Cousins will make his return to Minnesota where he should help boost the entire offense for the Vikings.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Tony Pollard (finger/rest) good to go for Sunday
items.desc: Tony Pollard (finger/rest) is good to go for Sunday's game against the Jacksonville Jaguars.
items.impact: Pollard will be fully good to go for Week 10, despite missing Thursday's practice with a minor finger issue and as a rest day. He will see almost all of the work in Tennessee's backfield if Tyjae Spears (knee) is ruled out ahead of game time.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Tyjae Spears (knee) questionable to play Sunday
items.desc: Tyjae Spears (knee) is questionable to play in Sunday's game against the Jacksonville Jaguars.
items.impact: Spears was upgraded to a full participant at practice on Friday, but he's still uncertain to play in Week 10 and is officially questionable to play heading into the weekend. Tony Pollard will continue to have a monopoly on the backfield if the 25-year old is unable to play this week.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Jaylon Moore (ankle) sidelined for Sunday
items.desc: Jaylon Moore (ankle) will be sidelined for Sunday's game against the Atlanta Falcons.
items.impact: Kansas City will be without their starting right tackle on Sunday. Moore is going to be sidelined due to an ankle issue, and it's unclear if it will cause him to miss more time beyond this game. Their offensive front will be weaker than usual while he's gone.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Rashee Rice (knee) good to go for Sunday
items.desc: Rashee Rice (knee) is good to go for Sunday's game against the Atlanta Falcons.
items.impact: Rice came into the week with a nagging knee issue of some kind, but it's not a serious issue and he has been fully cleared to play in Week 10. He may see more work in the receiving game if Kansas City's rushing attack is crippled by the potential absence of Kenneth Walker III (groin) this week.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Jaydn Ott (hamstring) listed questionable for Sunday
items.desc: Jaydn Ott (hamstring) is listed questionable for Sunday's game against the Atlanta Falcons.
items.impact: Ott is uncertain to play on Sunday. He is currently dealing with a hamstring issue and was limited at Friday's practice as a result, but he may be able to play through it this weekend. If he and Kenneth Walker III (groin) are both ruled out, Emmett Johnson will be set to have a monopoly on Kansas City's backfield this week.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Xavier Worthy (hamstring) without injury designation for Sunday
items.desc: Xavier Worthy (hamstring) is without an injury designation for Sunday's game against the Atlanta Falcons.
items.impact: Worthy is over his hamstring injury at this point and carries no injury designation heading into the weekend. He isn't a reliable week-to-week fantasy option at this point, but he could still put up a good performance if he's able to connect with QB Patrick Mahomes II on a big play at some point.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Mansoor Delane (shoulder) questionable for Sunday
items.desc: Mansoor Delane (shoulder) is questionable for Sunday's game against the Atlanta Falcons.
items.impact: The Chiefs may be without Delane for another game in Week 10, as he is currently considered questionable to play due to the shoulder injury that he's managing. Kansas City's secondary will be worse if he's unable to suit up and play this week.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Travis Kelce (ankle) good to go for Sunday
items.desc: Travis Kelce (ankle) is good to go for Sunday's game against the Atlanta Falcons.
items.impact: As expected, Kelce was able to practice all week and will be good to go for Sunday's game against the Falcons. He will continue to be a safe PPR option on a week-to-week basis, though his ceiling isn't all that high at this point in his career.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Kenneth Walker III (groin) officially questionable for Sunday
items.desc: Kenneth Walker III (groin) is officially questionable for Sunday's game against the Atlanta Falcons.
items.impact: Walker surprisingly missed Kansas City's practice on Friday due to a groin injury, and that same issue is going to leave him questionable to play heading into the weekend. The team will evaluate his status again closer to game time, and fantasy managers should expect Emmett Johnson to see a large workload and be a good fantasy option if Walker is unable to play against the Falcons this week.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Patrick Mahomes II (knee/elbow) off injury report for Sunday
items.desc: Patrick Mahomes II (knee/elbow) is off of the injury report for Sunday's game against the Atlanta Falcons.
items.impact: Mahomes was dealing with a couple of different issues at practice throughout the week, but neither of them are serious and he is off of the injury report heading into Week 10. He will start and may be a worthy streaming option this week, although Kansas City's offense will struggle more if Kenneth Walker III (groin) is ruled out.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Derrick Harmon (foot) questionable for Sunday
items.desc: Derrick Harmon (foot) is questionable for Sunday's game against the Cincinnati Bengals.
items.impact: Harmon was able to log a full practice session on Friday and is officially questionable to play in Week 10. Pittsburgh's defensive front will see a nice boost if he's cleared to play ahead of Sunday night's pivotal matchup against the Bengals.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Travis Etienne Jr. (hamstring) listed questionable Sunday
items.desc: Travis Etienne Jr. is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Panthers.
items.impact: Etienne was limited in practice to start the week before ending the week with a full practice. His status will need to be monitored closer to kickoff.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Taliese Fuaga (knee) ruled out Sunday
items.desc: Taliese Fuaga has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Panthers.
items.impact: Fuaga has a knee sprain. He is week-to-week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Alvin Kamara (rest/back) off injury report Sunday
items.desc: Alvin Kamara is off the injury report for Sunday's game against the Panthers.
items.impact: Kamara will be good to go in his passing down role in the Saints backfield.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: CJ Donaldson (shoulder) ruled out Sunday
items.desc: CJ Donaldson has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Panthers.
items.impact: Donaldson will be sidelined after missing practice all week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Kam Curl (toe) listed questionable Sunday
items.desc: Kam Curl is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Cardinals.
items.impact: Curl did not practice on Thursday. He will need to be monitored closer to kickoff.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Trent McDuffie (back) listed questionable Sunday
items.desc: Trent McDuffie is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Cardinals.
items.impact: McDuffie was hopeful to play on Sunday. His status will need to be monitored closer to kickoff.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Steve Avila (hamstring) ruled out Sunday
items.desc: Steve Avila has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Cardinals.
items.impact: Avila will be sidelined after missing practice all week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Terrance Ferguson (ankle/hamstring) ruled out Sunday
items.desc: Terrance Ferguson has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Cardinals.
items.impact: Ferguson will remain sidelined as expected after he re-aggravated his hamstring injury last week.
